QuestionText: The instructor provides students with a hard or soft copy of the course syllabus during the first week of the semester
The instructor is committed to the course syllabus and presents it in an organized manner to enable students for follow up
The instructor is keen to start and end lectures on time
The instructor is keen to follow on students' attendance
The instructor is keen to inculcate students with values of virtue, morality and national loyalty
The instructor receives questions and suggestions from students, respect their viewpoints and encourages objectives criticism
The instructor uses lecture time in a productive (effective) instruction
The instructor emphasizes fairness and avoids biases in dealing with students
The instructor pays attention to the preparation of the tests with comprehensive questions, suitable to the test time, distribution of marks and fit students abilities
The instructor corrects exams, reports and homwork and hands them back to students
The instructor reviews exams with students
The instructor uses information technology and communnication and learning resources in the learning/teaching processes in light of available resources
The instructor is keen to create comfortable classroom environment during lectures and exams
The instructor is committed to student's appointments (office hours) and gives them enough time
The instructor is considerate to common atmosphere in terms of general appearance, using language, and acting in accordance with academic norms
The instructor always encourages and stimulates students to enhance learning and motivation
The instructor enriches class discussions and increases students interest in the course
The instructor shows knowledge of course materials and subjects
The instructor assigns homework, reading, and research activities and expects students to accomplish them using library and e-resources
The instructor treats students in a friendly and respectful manner and stands out as a good example for them
